name: DVOL-vs-VIX divergence — buy when crypto IV stress is overdone vs a calm equity tape
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (a RELATIVE-VALUE read across two implied-vol surfaces, distinct from every single-gauge vol spec: dvol-calm/dvol-spike/macro-vix-* each read ONE vol index; this trades the SPREAD between crypto-native DVOL and equity VIX): DVOL is the crypto options market's implied vol, VIX the equity options market's. When DVOL is ELEVATED while VIX stays CALM, the stress is CRYPTO-SPECIFIC, not a systemic macro risk-off — and crypto-idiosyncratic IV spikes (a single hack, a leverage flush, an exchange scare) tend to mean-revert FASTER than macro panics because there is no broad-deleveraging feedback loop pinning them. So a high DVOL with a low VIX flags an over-priced crypto-only fear premium that decays: buy spot into it. The two-gauge structure is the edge — DVOL alone (dvol-spike) can't tell crypto-specific stress from a macro crash; pairing it with a CALM VIX isolates the idiosyncratic, fast-reverting case. Entry: dvol above a fitted crypto-stress floor AND vix_level below a fitted macro-calm ceiling (stress is crypto-only) AND price not in freefall (trend floor). Exit: dvol crosses down through a calm threshold (crypto IV premium decayed) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if dvol ALONE (dvol-spike-iv-capitulation) does as well, the VIX-calm leg adds nothing and the divergence thesis is unsupported. Disconfirmer 2: if an unconditional dip-buy matches the deflated Sharpe, neither vol gauge adds anything. Disconfirmer 3 (data depth): only ~148 DVOL and ~56 VIX points overlap — low-confidence, paper-only until both deepen. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): the reversion must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 crypto-native + tier0 macro vol features.
catalyst: elevated crypto DVOL while equity VIX is calm — an over-priced crypto-specific fear premium that decays
